mapper.select: SELECT supplier.ID, supplier.COMPANY_NAME, supplier.SOURCE, supplier.CREATE_TIME, supplier.STATUS, business.STAIRCLASSIFY_ID, business.STAIRCLASSIFY_NAME, business.ACCESSCLASSIFY_ID, business.ACCESSCLASSIFY_NAME, business.RECLASSIFY_ID, business.RECLASSIFY_NAME, relation.BUSINESSADMIN_NAME, relation.BUSINESSADMIN_PHONE FROM BP_SUPPLIER supplier right join BP_BUSINESS_SCOPE business on supplier.id = business.SUPPLIER_ID left join BP_RELATION relation on relation.SUPPLIER_ID = supplier.id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
